summary: secretlens gem exfiltrates host identifiers and system files to Burp Collaborator endpoint at install time
details: The gem declares ext/mkrf_conf.rb as a native extension, which causes it to auto-execute during `gem install`. The script performs no build work; instead it collects the installer's current working directory, home directory, hostname, login name, and the contents of /etc/resolv.conf, /etc/passwd, and /etc/hosts, encodes them as JSON, and POSTs them over TLS via a raw TCPSocket to the hardcoded out-of-band host o4tu99b5grs2rvps0y4epz6bt2ztrhh56.oastify.com:443 (a Burp Collaborator / interactsh subdomain). It then writes lib/.installed as a sentinel. There is no legitimate native-extension source tree accompanying the declared extension; the extension slot exists solely to run the beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
